_comment: FALLBACK ONLY — you normally never touch this file.
Use it if sign-in fails with 'You do not have permission to call UrlFetchApp.fetch'
AND running authorizeNow() never shows an authorization dialog. That combination means
your project pins its scopes explicitly, so Apps Script will not add the missing one.
In the Apps Script editor: Project Settings (gear) -> tick 'Show appsscript.json manifest
file in editor' -> open appsscript.json -> paste the oauthScopes array below into it,
keeping your own timeZone value -> Save -> run authorizeNow() -> accept the prompt ->
Deploy -> Manage deployments -> pencil -> New version -> Deploy.
Each scope maps to something this script actually does:
script.send_mail         send the daily mini-lesson and invite emails (MailApp)
script.scriptapp         install and read the daily trigger (ScriptApp)
userinfo.email           know which account owns the script, so the owner is always a member
